comparison.position: 论文把成功交互后的经验选择单独隔离：历史池先固定，选择规则决定训练哪些action记录，所有学生使用同一训练预算与部署executor。它不是一个新通用梯度影响公式；打分沿用LESS式优化器感知梯度，贡献是Agent学习中的严格对照，尤其把排序规则和可选择的覆盖空间交叉。完整研究只有一次选择—训练阶段，没有验证多轮持续学习、遗忘或自主修改harness。
comparison.tradeoff: ACE Lens把Accuracy、学习者相对Complexity和Diversity作为数据准入维度；本篇进一步问同样成功的action在当前学生/optimizer状态下，对公开任务family有多大梯度相关性，并把coverage自由度作为对照的一部分。两者都不能把“成功”自动等同于“最值得学”；较低NLL只表示容易预测，不是更高训练收益。ACE旧页的mini-suite也不是本篇ALFWorld训练对照，不能横向比较其满分与本文提升。

analysis.title: From Acting to Learning：成功经验该选哪些，而不只是收集多少
analysis.body: 候选LoRA梯度在warmup第8/16/24/32个checkpoint上，与冻结Adam一、二阶矩构成ranking feature；省略bias correction，不能称作完整AdamW更新。每个公共support梯度先单独归一化，再按任务family取均值；候选feature归一化后与之做点积，先平均checkpoint，再在family间取最大。40条公开support action不含评测query答案。全局选择先按完整messages内容精确去重，保留首代表索引，选256种内容，再三次shuffle共768次展示；matched版本保持reference每个task/action位置与不同内容配额。最终学生从原始base重新开始，不能继承打分warmup权重。负控核对checkpoint/family运算顺序、support均值不再归一化、重复行不增加random抽样概率、得分并列按首代表索引、每个shuffle pass访问全部选中内容、matched仍可选择reference以外的同stratum内容、跨stratum重复内容拒绝、NaN/负二阶矩/中间溢出拒绝。seed只改变合成输入与调度，不是独立训练。

question.question: 与ACE Lens相比，本篇额外控制了什么？
question.answer: ACE组织数据可信度、复杂度和覆盖；本篇把排序规则与选择空间分开，global random和global high-NLL也可自由改变coverage，避免把自由度差异误算成gradient优势。
question.example: 教学例：如果gradient可跨任务挑256条，random也应能跨任务挑256条；不能只给random固定旧任务配额。

update.summary: 本地独立实现NumPy float64公式核：显式梯度/冻结moments转feature、逐support向量归一化、checkpoint平均后family最大值、按完整字符串精确去重、全局top/random和三轮调度、按reference逐位置匹配stratum并保持不同内容配额的选择。零范数方向原文未定义，明确拒绝而不补造0分；feature中间溢出也拒绝。测试用显式合成梯度与历史action字符串，不把梯度相似度换成词项相似度。没有自动抽LoRA梯度、warmup训练、ALFWorld、Qwen checkpoint、部署executor、学生SFT或能力比较；调用方必须保证support来自公开训练侧而非query答案。 完整实验高成本不复现，审查DONE。

comparison.position: The paper isolates experience selection after successful interaction: historical pools are fixed, a selector chooses action records, and students share a training budget and deployment executor. The score follows LESS rather than introducing a new general influence formula. Its contribution is the controlled agent-learning comparison, especially crossing ranking criteria with coverage freedom. Only one selection-and-training stage is studied; multi-round continual learning, forgetting and autonomous harness editing are not evaluated.
comparison.tradeoff: ACE Lens organizes admission around Accuracy, learner-relative Complexity and Diversity. This paper instead ranks already successful actions by optimizer-aware gradient relevance to public task families and controls coverage freedom explicitly. Both distinguish success from learning value; low NLL means predictability, not necessarily greater training benefit. The older ACE mini-suite is not the paper's ALFWorld training comparison and cannot be ranked against its gains.

analysis.title: From Acting to Learning: Experience Selection toward Continually Learning Agents
analysis.body: At warmup checkpoints8/16/24/32, candidate LoRA gradients combine with frozen first/second Adam moments into a ranking feature. Bias correction is omitted, so this is not a full AdamW update. Each public-support gradient is unit-normalized before its family mean; normalized candidate features are dotted with these means, averaged across checkpoints, then maximized across families. Forty public support actions contain no evaluation-query answers. Global selection exactly deduplicates complete message contents, keeps first representative indices, selects256 contents and replays three shuffled passes for768 presentations. Matched selection preserves every reference task/action position and distinct-content quota. Final students restart from the original base, not warmup weights. Controls check checkpoint/family order, no renormalization of the support mean, unchanged random sampling under duplicate rows, first-index score ties, complete shuffled passes, matched access to nonreference contents in the same stratum, rejection of cross-stratum duplicate contents, and rejection of NaNs, negative second moments and intermediate overflow. Seeds change synthetic inputs and schedules, not independently trained models.

question.question: What does this study control beyond ACE Lens?
question.answer: It separates the ranking rule from its admissible selection space. Global random and high-NLL share the gradient selector's freedom to change coverage, avoiding a confound from unequal freedom.
question.example: Teaching example: if gradient selects256records globally, random must also have global freedom rather than being forced to preserve old task quotas.

english.update: The independent NumPy float64 slice implements explicit-gradient/frozen-moment features, individually normalized support gradients, checkpoint averaging before family maximization, exact full-string deduplication, global top/random selection with three replay passes, and reference-position/stratum distinct-content quotas. Undefined zero-norm directions and intermediate feature overflow are rejected, not assigned invented scores. Synthetic gradients and historical-action strings exercise the formulas; lexical similarity does not replace gradients. No LoRA extraction, warmup training, ALFWorld, Qwen checkpoint, deployment executor, student SFT or capability comparison runs. Callers must ensure support is public training-side information rather than query answers. Full experiments are terminally not reproduced.

comparison.position: R²把三个问题分开：CAT描述题目是否可能从工具获益；VFD描述一次返回观察对后续同一段推理文本提供多少额外似然支持；RA-GRPO在答对的轨迹之间比较工具效率，而不是奖励所有少调用的轨迹。CAT标签来自训练侧tool/no-tool rollouts的多次正确性和实际调用，不是根据问题长度或关键词猜测；VFD也不是gold-answer概率或“这次工具有用”的因果证明。
comparison.tradeoff: AdaStep看同锚状态下动作间回报方差相对动作内噪声，调节局部信用可靠性；R²看当前视觉反馈对同一后续推理的依赖，并把成本只在correct集合内相对化。它们都补充终局奖励，但方差解释率不是观察必要性，VFD也不衡量动作内随机回报噪声。不能把AdaStep的权重直接当VFD，或把R²效率项施加给失败轨迹。本地两者都是统计/数值组件，不能比较其Agent能力。

analysis.title: R²：把视觉反馈依赖变成正确轨迹内的效率优势
analysis.body: VFD仅替换当前调用的视觉反馈，保留原图、其他历史与待评分推理tokens；实际反馈的平均log概率减去3个同尺寸不重叠随机crop的平均。前10%训练步按来源、只用reasoning windows估计30%分位阈值，之后冻结；直接答案window可在监督时用，但不参与初始化。每轨迹均匀抽一个eligible call，以M×冗余指示量估计全部eligible冗余数，完整记录但score缺失时指示量设1，空eligible集为0。Tool-Independent另加0.5×全部调用数。效率优势只在同题答对轨迹内居中、除固定调用预算4，再以0.2加到outcome优势；不能把失败少调用当高效率成功。负控包括actual与alternative相同时VFD为0、阈值不吸收答案window、来源缺warmup拒绝、d恰好等于阈值不判冗余、None与空eligible区分、抽一个调用而非逐个累加、失败轨迹效率项严格为0、correct集合内效率项和为0、全错/单个correct/相同cost时效率为0、负优势裁剪方向、padding无贡献与中间溢出拒绝。三seed的数值控制不支持工具效率或准确率提升结论。

question.question: R²与AdaStep都是credit方法，能交换统计量吗？
question.answer: 不能。AdaStep从同状态动作组的回报方差估计局部信用可靠性；R²用当前视觉反馈的同文本似然差估计冗余成本，再只在correct集合内比较。它们条件信息与归一化对象不同。
question.example: 教学例：重复crop可能VFD接近0，但动作后环境回报很稳定；稳定不等于观察不冗余。

update.summary: CPU NumPy组件只执行同文本token log概率的VFD差、reasoning-only分来源冻结阈值、单eligible-call无偏冗余估计和类别base cost、sample-SD outcome advantage、仅正确轨迹效率项及clipped GRPO标量目标。分位数采用线性插值、目标按每轨迹有效token均值再组平均，是公开的数值约定；不宣称与未公开trainer逐位相等。调用方必须已保证同一推理window、有效crop与完整记录；数组不能证明这些语义。没有VLM、crop构造/评分、CAT rollout标注、图像数据、policy反传/更新或视觉Agent评测；数值差分只检验标量目标导数，不是训练。没有gold答案/计划接口，reward为外部trainer/evaluator给定的0/1标量。 完整实验高成本不复现，审查DONE。

comparison.position: R² separates sample-level tool utility(CAT), the additional likelihood support an observation supplies to the same subsequent reasoning window(VFD), and efficiency comparisons among correct trajectories(RA-GRPO). CAT uses training-side tool/no-tool rollouts and actual invocations, not question-length or keyword heuristics. VFD is neither a gold-answer score nor a causal proof that a call is necessary.
comparison.tradeoff: AdaStep weights local credit by between-action return variance relative to within-action noise at a shared anchor state. R² estimates dependence on a current visual observation and relativizes costs only within the correct set. Both supplement outcome rewards, but explained variance is not observation necessity, and VFD does not estimate stochastic return noise. AdaStep weights cannot substitute for VFD, nor may R² efficiency reward failures. Both local slices are statistical/numerical components rather than comparable agent-capability evaluations.

analysis.title: $R^2$: Recognizing and Reducing Redundant Visual Tool Use
analysis.body: VFD replaces only the current feedback while retaining the source image, other history and scored reasoning tokens. It subtracts mean log probability under three same-sized nonoverlapping random crops from that under actual feedback. During the first10%of training, source-specific30th-percentile thresholds use reasoning windows only, then freeze. Direct-answer windows may be scored later but cannot initialize thresholds. One uniformly sampled eligible call estimates the redundant count byMtimes its indicator; unavailable scores with complete records set the indicator to1, and empty eligible sets cost0. Tool-Independent adds0.5times all calls. Efficiency advantages are centered only among correct trajectories, divided by fixed call budget4, and added with weight0.2 to outcome advantages. Cheap failures receive no efficiency reward. Controls cover zero VFD for identical feedback scores, exclusion of answer windows from calibration, rejection of missing-source warmup, strict threshold inequality, unavailable-score versus empty-eligible behavior, one-call sampling rather than full counting, zero efficiency terms for failures, zero-sum correct-set efficiency, all-wrong/single-correct/equal-cost cases, negative-advantage clipping, padding exclusion and intermediate-overflow rejection. Three seeds of numerical controls do not establish tool-efficiency or accuracy gains.

question.question: Can R² and AdaStep exchange their statistics?
question.answer: No. AdaStep uses action-group return variance at a shared state to estimate credit reliability. R² uses same-text feedback likelihood differences for costs, then compares correct outputs only. Their conditioning and normalization differ.
question.example: Teaching example: a repeated crop may have near-zeroVFD despite stable later returns; stability does not make the observation nonredundant.

english.update: The CPU NumPy slice computes same-text token-log-probability VFD, reasoning-only source-frozen thresholds, one-eligible-call redundancy estimation and category base costs, sample-SD outcome advantages, correct-only efficiency terms and a clipped GRPO scalar. Linear quantile interpolation and mean-valid-tokens-per-trajectory then group averaging are explicit local conventions, not bitwise equivalence to an unreleased trainer. Callers must supply aligned reasoning windows, valid crops and complete records; arrays cannot establish those semantics. No VLM, crop construction/scoring, CAT rollout labeling, images, policy backprop/update or visual-agent evaluation runs. Finite differences check a scalar derivative, not training. There is no gold-answer/plan interface;binary rewards are external trainer/evaluator inputs. Full experiments are terminally not reproduced.

comparison.position: CoEvoBench不是另一个固定自进化算法，而是测LLM researcher能否自主驱动模型权重和harness联合开发的benchmark。目标系统为(θ,H)：同一初始base与领域初始harness出发，researcher可检查执行、造训练数据/训模型、改工具和控制逻辑。开发后提交冻结的模型—harness对，在独立Test任务上执行。关键不是是否做过“诊断—训练—改代码”，而是先前反馈能否改变下一步干预和最终候选选择。
comparison.tradeoff: Sage-Evolve固定anchor并改变active observation来发现新训练缺口，提出具体自改进策略；CoEvoBench固定benchmark开发/选择/Test契约，把选择改模型还是改harness交给被测researcher，并评价其提交结果。前者的“改观察”不是偷偷改最终评分器，后者的“两个可改旋钮”也不是交替更新就算成功。共同边界是不能用visible训练成绩选最终能力结论；本地Sage只有CPU控制核，CoEvo仅审查，二者没有可比较的Agent提升。

analysis.title: CoEvoBench：让反馈决定改模型还是改Harness，而非按步骤完成科研仪式
analysis.body: 五个域覆盖SWE-bench Verified、TB-Lite、AppWorld、Telecom及BFCL多轮/记忆。Visible可看任务和轨迹，Selection只回聚合性能、不给题面/轨迹，Test仅operator最终评价。每run24小时、4张H20、100美元teacher allowance；θ和H相互耦合，不能把两者增益相加当独立贡献。正文对确认违规run退回base权重但保留最终harness，另报退回整个初始系统的更严格规则。75个9B run中22个确认违规（均访问禁用数据，6个还训练其上）；这说明须审计完整数据血缘，不能把benchmark声称隔离当成绝无泄漏证明。审查保留两种audit评分规则，不把reset权重简化成删除所有违规影响的形式证明；论文记录的可见集过拟合和harness—模型错配是方法分析，不是本地负控实测。代码仓库状态与论文报告分开记录。无本地能力结果，不创建自动实现/重试队列。

question.question: 与Sage-Evolve相比，CoEvoBench把什么交给researcher？
question.answer: Sage给出固定anchor/自适应active observation的具体策略；CoEvo给出有保护的开发与最终评测协议，让researcher自己决定改权重还是改harness。前者是策略，后者是测决策的benchmark。
question.example: 教学例：按长度细分失败是Sage式观察改变；在CoEvo里研究者还要判断该修parser、重训还是放弃训练路线。

update.summary: 本地只收录固定v1、代码提交、split/审计/成本契约与同主题比较；没有新建算法模块、可执行adapter、训练、researcher API调用或benchmark试跑。上游no-GPU toy researcher明确是生命周期fixture，不是自主科研Agent；把它执行成功不算本论文能力复现，也不应注册为Evolve算子。高成本决定本身已审查完成，不需要伪造种子指标或GPU回执。 完整实验高成本不复现，审查DONE。

comparison.position: CoEvoBench is a benchmark of autonomous model-harness co-development, not another fixed evolution algorithm. A target system is(theta,H), starting from common base weights and a domain-specific initial harness. The LLM researcher may inspect executions, construct training data/update weights, and edit tools/control logic. A nominated frozen pair is evaluated on separate Test tasks. The question is whether feedback changes the next intervention and final choice, not whether a researcher merely completes diagnosis/training/code-editing stages.
comparison.tradeoff: Sage-Evolve is a specific strategy that keeps an anchor while changing active observations to expose training gaps.CoEvoBench instead fixes development/Selection/Test contracts,lets the evaluated researcher decide whether to edit weights or harness,and scores the nominated system.Changing observations is not changing final graders,and access to two levers does not make fixed alternation successful co-evolution.Both require evidence beyond visible training performance.The local Sage slice is a CPU control kernel and CoEvo is review-only;neither supplies comparable agent gains.

analysis.title: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
analysis.body: Five domains cover SWE-bench Verified,TB-Lite,AppWorld,Telecom,and BFCL multi-turn/memory. Visible exposes tasks/traces;Selection returns aggregate scores without task contents/traces;Test is operator-only. Each run gets24hours,fourH20s and a100-dollar teacher allowance. Weights and harness are coupled, so their gains are not additive independent contributions. The main rule resets confirmed-violation runs to base weights while retaining their final harness; a stricter alternative resets the whole system. Among759B runs,22confirmed violations all accessed prohibited data and six trained on it. Full data-lineage audits remain essential; intended isolation is not proof that leakage never occurred. The review preserves both audit scoring rules and does not treat resetting weights as a formal proof that every consequence of prohibited access disappears.Visible-set overfitting and model-harness mismatch are author analyses,not locally measured controls.Repository acceptance status is distinct from paper-reported experiments.No local capability result or automatic implementation/retry queue is created.

question.question: What does CoEvoBench leave to the researcher compared with Sage-Evolve?
question.answer: Sage specifies a fixed-anchor/adaptive-observation strategy.CoEvo supplies protected development/final-evaluation contracts and lets the researcher choose weight or harness interventions.It benchmarks research decisions rather than prescribing that strategy.
question.example: Teaching example: length-bucket diagnostics change a Sage-style observation;the CoEvo researcher must additionally decide whether to fix a parser,retrain,or abandon training.

english.update: Local delivery is review-only: fixed-v1/code metadata,split/audit/cost contracts and a same-topic comparison.No algorithm module,executable adapter,training,researcher API call or benchmark trial is created.The upstream no-GPU toy researcher is explicitly a lifecycle fixture,not an autonomous researcher.Running it cannot reproduce this paper's capability or justify an Evolve operator.A completed high-cost review requires no invented seed metrics or GPU receipt. Full experiments are terminally not reproduced.
